shared_elements: winged disc / arched sky motif in the lunette
row of small standing human/deity figures in profile
horizontal register lines dividing the field
justification: Both are round-topped stelae with a winged/arched sky emblem in the lunette, beneath which stand profile figures with staffs and disc-crowned heads accompanied by columns of the same script, all divided by horizontal register lines — a highly specific and conventional shared scheme. The main difference is proportion of content: A devotes nearly the whole surface to many dense lines of text with only a small figural strip, whereas B gives a large figural scene of two confronted standing figures flanking a central element with only brief captions.
